image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a handmade or craft-style bib lying on a blue textured fabric background. The bib features a translucent or semi-transparent light blue outer layer with an orange stitched border. Inside or layered beneath the transparent layer are various colorful fabric scraps, including pink yarn-like bundles, green and white rectangular patches, and other multicolored textile pieces. Two long, thin straps (orange and green) extend from the top neck area, looping around.
